CREATE TABLE `bridge_jobrequire` (
   `bridge_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
   `fact_id` bigint NOT NULL,
   `require_id` int NOT NULL,
   PRIMARY KEY (`bridge_id`),
   UNIQUE KEY `uq_fact_require` (`fact_id`,`require_id`),
   KEY `idx_fact` (`fact_id`),
   KEY `idx_require` (`require_id`),
   CONSTRAINT `FK_bridge_fact` FOREIGN KEY (`fact_id`) REFERENCES `fact_jobpostings` (`posting_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
 ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=131071 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

   `cap_bac_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

   UNIQUE KEY `uq_ten` (`ten_cap_bac`)
 ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=22 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

   `cong_ty_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

 ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=16390 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

 \CREATE TABLE `jobs` (
   `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

 USE itta;
DELIMITER $$

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS sp_ETL_Load_DW$$

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_ETL_Load_DW(
    IN p_mode VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_date DATE
)
BEGIN

    SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 0. MIGRATION
    -- =========================================================================

    -- Dim_DanhMucCongViec: drop is_it
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Dim_DanhMucCongViec' AND COLUMN_NAME='is_it') > 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Dim_DanhMucCongViec DROP COLUMN is_it',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: drop is_vn
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='is_vn') > 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings DROP COLUMN is_vn',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add is_it
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='is_it') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN is_it TINYINT(1) NULL AFTER danh_muc_id',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add ngay_dang
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='ngay_dang') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN ngay_dang DATE NULL AFTER is_it',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add job_title_detect
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='job_title_detect') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN job_title_detect VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER job_title_clean',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add is_duplicate
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='is_duplicate') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN is_duplicate TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 AFTER is_it',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add duplicate_of_id
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='duplicate_of_id') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN duplicate_of_id BIGINT NULL AFTER is_duplicate',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: add dedup_method
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Fact_JobPostings' AND COLUMN_NAME='dedup_method') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings ADD COLUMN dedup_method VARCHAR(20) NULL AFTER duplicate_of_id',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- Fact_JobPostings: modify job_title_clean
    ALTER TABLE Fact_JobPostings MODIFY COLUMN job_title_clean VARCHAR(500) NULL;

    -- Dim_DiaDiem: add is_vn
    SET @s = IF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
         WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='Dim_DiaDiem' AND COLUMN_NAME='is_vn') = 0,
        'ALTER TABLE Dim_DiaDiem ADD COLUMN is_vn TINYINT(1) NULL AFTER vung',
        'SELECT 1');
    PREPARE _s FROM @s; EXECUTE _s; DEALLOCATE PREPARE _s;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 0.5 TRUNCATE KHI MODE = 'all'
    -- =========================================================================
    IF p_mode = 'all' THEN
        SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0;
        TRUNCATE TABLE bridge_jobrequire;
        TRUNCATE TABLE Fact_JobPostings;
        TRUNCATE TABLE fact_pipeline_snapshot;
        SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1;
    END IF;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 1. DIM_NGUON
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_Nguon (ten_nguon)
    SELECT DISTINCT website_clean
    FROM   fact_jobs_etl
    WHERE  website_clean IS NOT NULL AND website_clean <> '';

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 2. DIM_CAPBAC
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_CapBac (ten_cap_bac)
    SELECT DISTINCT level_clean
    FROM   fact_jobs_etl
    WHERE  level_clean IS NOT NULL AND level_clean <> '';

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 3. DIM_HINHTHUC
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_HinhThuc (job_type, work_mode)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(job_type_clean,  ''), 'Full-time'),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(work_mode_clean, ''), 'Onsite')
    FROM fact_jobs_etl;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 4. DIM_NGANH
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_Nganh (cap_do_1, cap_do_2)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        industry_level1,
        industry_level2
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    WHERE industry_level1 IS NOT NULL AND industry_level1 <> '';

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 5. DIM_DIADIEM
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_DiaDiem (tinh_thanh, vung, is_vn)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        location_province,
        location_region,
        is_vn
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    WHERE location_province IS NOT NULL AND location_province <> '';

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 6. DIM_CONGTY
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT INTO Dim_CongTy (ten_cong_ty, canonical_key, company_type, quy_mo_min, quy_mo_max)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(company_name_clean), ''), 'Unknown') AS ten_cong_ty,
            company_canonical_key AS canonical_key,
            company_type,
            company_size_min      AS quy_mo_min,
            company_size_max      AS quy_mo_max
        FROM fact_jobs_etl
        WHERE is_duplicate = 0
    ) nr
    ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
        canonical_key = COALESCE(nr.canonical_key, Dim_CongTy.canonical_key),
        company_type  = COALESCE(nr.company_type,  Dim_CongTy.company_type),
        quy_mo_min    = COALESCE(nr.quy_mo_min,    Dim_CongTy.quy_mo_min),
        quy_mo_max    = COALESCE(nr.quy_mo_max,    Dim_CongTy.quy_mo_max);

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 7. DIM_DANHMUCCONGVIEC
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_DanhMucCongViec (ten_danh_muc)
    SELECT DISTINCT job_category_clean
    FROM   fact_jobs_etl
    WHERE  job_category_clean IS NOT NULL
      AND  job_category_clean <> '';

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 8. FACT_JOBPOSTINGS — load TẤT CẢ (kể cả duplicate)
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT INTO Fact_JobPostings (
        etl_id, job_url, ngay_dang, dia_diem_id, cong_ty_id, nganh_id,
        cap_bac_id, hinh_thuc_id, nguon_id, danh_muc_id,
        is_it, is_duplicate, duplicate_of_id, dedup_method,
        job_title_clean, job_title_detect, so_luong_tuyen,
        salary_min, salary_max, salary_avg, salary_currency,
        conversion_rate, is_negotiable, exp_min_yr, exp_max_yr,
        is_exp_required, etl_run_id, ngay_crawl, ngay_deadline
    )
    SELECT
        src.etl_id,
        src.job_url,
        src.job_posted_at_clean,
        dd.dia_diem_id,
        ct.cong_ty_id,
        ng.nganh_id,
        cb.cap_bac_id,
        ht.hinh_thuc_id,
        ns.nguon_id,
        dm.danh_muc_id,
        src.is_it,
        src.is_duplicate,
        src.duplicate_of_id,
        src.dedup_method,
        src.job_title_clean,
        src.job_title_detect,
        COALESCE(src.number_recruit_clean, 1),
        src.salary_min,
        src.salary_max,
        CASE
            WHEN src.salary_min IS NOT NULL AND src.salary_max IS NOT NULL
                THEN ROUND((src.salary_min + src.salary_max) / 2)
            WHEN src.salary_min IS NOT NULL THEN src.salary_min
            WHEN src.salary_max IS NOT NULL THEN src.salary_max
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        src.salary_currency,
        src.conversion_rate,
        src.is_negotiable,
        src.exp_min_yr,
        src.exp_max_yr,
        src.is_exp_required,
        src.etl_run_id,
        DATE(src.scraped_at),
        src.job_deadline_clean
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    LEFT JOIN Dim_DiaDiem dd
           ON src.location_province = dd.tinh_thanh
    LEFT JOIN Dim_CongTy ct
           ON COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(src.company_name_clean), ''), 'Unknown') = ct.ten_cong_ty
    LEFT JOIN Dim_Nganh ng
           ON src.industry_level1 = ng.cap_do_1
          AND src.industry_level2 = ng.cap_do_2
    LEFT JOIN Dim_CapBac cb
           ON src.level_clean = cb.ten_cap_bac
    LEFT JOIN Dim_HinhThuc ht
           ON COALESCE(NULLIF(src.job_type_clean,  ''), 'Full-time') = ht.job_type
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(src.work_mode_clean, ''), 'Onsite')    = ht.work_mode
    LEFT JOIN Dim_Nguon ns
           ON src.website_clean = ns.ten_nguon
    LEFT JOIN Dim_DanhMucCongViec dm
           ON src.job_category_clean = dm.ten_danh_muc
    WHERE src.is_valid = 1
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      )
    ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
        is_it            = VALUES(is_it),
        is_duplicate     = VALUES(is_duplicate),
        duplicate_of_id  = VALUES(duplicate_of_id),
        dedup_method     = VALUES(dedup_method),
        ngay_dang        = VALUES(ngay_dang),
        job_title_clean  = VALUES(job_title_clean),
        job_title_detect = VALUES(job_title_detect),
        so_luong_tuyen   = VALUES(so_luong_tuyen),
        salary_min       = VALUES(salary_min),
        salary_max       = VALUES(salary_max),
        salary_avg       = VALUES(salary_avg),
        salary_currency  = VALUES(salary_currency),
        conversion_rate  = VALUES(conversion_rate),
        is_negotiable    = VALUES(is_negotiable),
        exp_min_yr       = VALUES(exp_min_yr),
        exp_max_yr       = VALUES(exp_max_yr),
        is_exp_required  = VALUES(is_exp_required),
        ngay_crawl       = VALUES(ngay_crawl),
        updated_at       = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 9. DIM_REQUIRE — chỉ từ job KHÔNG duplicate (tránh inflate)
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO Dim_Require (require_type, require_value)
    SELECT DISTINCT 'hard_skill', TRIM(val)
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(hard_skills, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    WHERE hard_skills IS NOT NULL AND is_duplicate = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT 'soft_skill', TRIM(val)
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(soft_skills, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    WHERE soft_skills IS NOT NULL AND is_duplicate = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT 'certification', TRIM(val)
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(certifications, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    WHERE certifications IS NOT NULL AND is_duplicate = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT 'language', TRIM(val)
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(languages, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    WHERE languages IS NOT NULL AND is_duplicate = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT 'major', TRIM(val)
    FROM fact_jobs_etl
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(major, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    WHERE major IS NOT NULL AND is_duplicate = 0;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 10. BRIDGE_JOBREQUIRE — chỉ từ job KHÔNG duplicate (tránh inflate)
    -- =========================================================================
    INSERT IGNORE INTO bridge_jobrequire (fact_id, require_id)
    SELECT f.posting_id, r.require_id
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    JOIN Fact_JobPostings f ON src.etl_id = f.etl_id
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(src.hard_skills, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    JOIN Dim_Require r
      ON r.require_type = 'hard_skill' AND r.require_value = TRIM(jt.val)
    WHERE src.hard_skills IS NOT NULL
      AND src.is_duplicate = 0
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT f.posting_id, r.require_id
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    JOIN Fact_JobPostings f ON src.etl_id = f.etl_id
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(src.soft_skills, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    JOIN Dim_Require r ON r.require_type = 'soft_skill' AND r.require_value = TRIM(jt.val)
    WHERE src.soft_skills IS NOT NULL
      AND src.is_duplicate = 0
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT f.posting_id, r.require_id
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    JOIN Fact_JobPostings f ON src.etl_id = f.etl_id
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(src.certifications, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    JOIN Dim_Require r ON r.require_type = 'certification' AND r.require_value = TRIM(jt.val)
    WHERE src.certifications IS NOT NULL
      AND src.is_duplicate = 0
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT f.posting_id, r.require_id
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    JOIN Fact_JobPostings f ON src.etl_id = f.etl_id
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(src.languages, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    JOIN Dim_Require r ON r.require_type = 'language' AND r.require_value = TRIM(jt.val)
    WHERE src.languages IS NOT NULL
      AND src.is_duplicate = 0
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT f.posting_id, r.require_id
    FROM fact_jobs_etl src
    JOIN Fact_JobPostings f ON src.etl_id = f.etl_id
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        CONCAT('["', REGEXP_REPLACE(src.major, '\\s*,\\s*', '","'), '"]'),
        '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$')
    ) jt
    JOIN Dim_Require r ON r.require_type = 'major' AND r.require_value = TRIM(jt.val)
    WHERE src.major IS NOT NULL
      AND src.is_duplicate = 0
      AND (
           p_mode = 'all'
        OR (p_mode = 'today' AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = CURDATE())
        OR (p_mode = 'date'  AND DATE(src.etl_processed_at) = p_date)
      );

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 12. VIEWS cho tầng report
    -- =========================================================================
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_JobPostings_Unique AS
    SELECT * FROM Fact_JobPostings WHERE is_duplicate = 0;

    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_JobPostings_All AS
    SELECT * FROM Fact_JobPostings;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- Status
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT CONCAT(
        'ETL DW hoàn tất — mode=', p_mode,
        IFNULL(CONCAT(' date=', p_date), '')
    ) AS status;

END$$
DELIMITER ;
